# Simple Icons sources

Vendored from [16.34.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/16.34.0). The library is distributed under CC0-1.0; individual brand sources, licenses where provided, and guidelines are retained in `metadata.json` and the upstream disclaimer in `DISCLAIMER.md`.

SVG path geometry is unchanged. Template wrappers use `fill="currentColor"`, the existing `social-icon` class, explicit 24px dimensions and accessibility attributes. Upstream SVG titles are omitted because the caller supplies the accessible label.
